metadata.name: MusicBERT
metadata.description: Symbolic music-understanding research-code candidate modeled as the MusicBERT subproject inside Microsoft's Muzic repository rather than as the entire Muzic umbrella.
metadata.provenance: Official microsoft/muzic repository status, root MIT LICENSE and musicbert/README.md reviewed on 2026-09-10 for #638. This catalog card is deliberately scoped to the repository's MusicBERT code subproject. The MusicBERT README links separately hosted pretrained checkpoints and processed datasets; this catalog does not assert that those external model/data assets inherit the repository MIT license and does not bundle them.
metadata.changelog: Catalog record v1; resolves MusicBERT as the Muzic musicbert code subproject while keeping separately distributed checkpoint and dataset licensing outside the MIT code claim.

metadata.name: LEGATO
metadata.description: Typeset optical-music-recognition model reference whose own code/model layer is not sufficient for use without a separately licensed Llama 3.2 Vision encoder.
metadata.license: Mixed: MIT / LGPL-3.0; Llama 3.2 Community License dependency
metadata.provenance: Official guang-yng/legato repository, README.md, LICENSE.md and model-loading code plus official Hugging Face LEGATO/Llama 3.2 Vision model cards reviewed on 2026-09-10 for #638. Most LEGATO code is MIT; utils/abc2xml.py is LGPL-3.0. LEGATO checkpoints are described as MIT, but the code loads meta-llama/Llama-3.2-11B-Vision as its vision encoder. That upstream model is gated under the separate Llama 3.2 Community License, whose multimodal grant excludes EU-domiciled developers/companies. The documented practical path is CUDA/GPU-backed and the full model card reports roughly 20GB+ full-precision GPU memory. No third-party executable code or model weights are bundled by this catalog.
metadata.changelog: Catalog record v1; resolves the LEGATO code/model identity but classifies it deferred because the practical model path requires a separately licensed gated Llama 3.2 multimodal encoder with an EU developer restriction.
